title: Skydance Sets Leadership Across Games, Experiences, Consumer Products and HR
content:
ByJennifer Maas

TV Business Writer

Skydancepresident Andy Gordon has solidified leadership positions across key areas outside of the companies TV and film divisions, including games and experiences, products and publishing, HR and global operations.

Additionally, Skydance has revealed that Paramount and WBD’s games and experiences divisions will be combined into one team, which oversee projects based on IP ranging from Paramount’s “Star Trek,” “Mission: Impossible,” “SpongeBob SquarePants,” “South Park,” “Avatar: The Last Airbender” and “The Godfather” to Warner Bros.’ “Harry Potter,” DC Universe, “Mortal Kombat,” “The Matrix,” “Rick and Morty” and “Game of Thrones.”

Notably, this means combining the newly formed Paramount Games Studio with Warner Bros. Games’ internal developers, including Avalanche Software, NetherRealm Studios, Rocksteady Studios, TT Games and the WB Games teams in Montreal and Boston.

In an email sent to staff Tuesday evening, which was obtained byVariety, Gordon announced the following:

“We’re investing in our future growth engines alongside our core ambitions in TV, Film and direct-to-consumer: Games, Experiences, Consumer Products, and Publishing,” Gordon wrote. “These are core pillars of our strategy to build engagement and fandom in both the physical and digital worlds. We want to meet consumers where they watch, play, and engage. At the same time, we see opportunities to build on DC Comics’ storytelling and expand our e-commerce offerings to connect fans with the brands they love.”

Games and experiences chief Driscoll (who was named head of Paramount’snewly launched video game studioin June, a combo of Paramount and Skydance’s gaming assets) laid out plans for his team in his own memo:

“We immerse our guests in theme parks, resorts, restaurants, retail, studio tours and more. We immerse our players in action, adventure, combat, competition and creativity, from ‘Batman’ to ‘SpongeBob.’ And no matter your role on this team, you are a creator, builder, operator, and steward of those worlds. We have the opportunity to create amazing spaces where friendships are formed and communities grow. That is only possible because of your hard work and talent. Whether it’s on Zoom or in person, my first priority in the coming weeks is meeting as many of you as I can from LA to London, Montreal to Tokyo, and beyond.”
title_zh: 天際線影業(Skydance)在遊戲、體驗、消費產品和人力資源領域設立領導團隊。
content_zh:
由珍妮佛·馬斯(Jennifer Maas)報導

電視商業撰稿人

Skydance的總裁安迪·戈登(Andy Gordon)已在公司電視和電影部門以外的關鍵領域鞏固了領導職位，包括遊戲和體驗、產品和出版、人力資源以及全球運營。

此外，Skydance還透露，派拉蒙(Paramount)和華納兄弟(WBD)的遊戲和體驗部門將合併為一個團隊，負責監督基於知識產權的項目，這些項目涵蓋了派拉蒙的《星際迷航(Star Trek)》、《不可能的任務(Mission: Impossible)》、《海綿寶寶(SpongeBob SquarePants)》、《南方公園(South Park)》、《降世神通：最後的氣宗(Avatar: The Last Airbender)》和《教父(The Godfather)》，以及華納兄弟的《哈利·波特(Harry Potter)》、《DC宇宙(DC Universe)》、《真人快打(Mortal Kombat)》、《黑客帝國(The Matrix)》、《瑞克與莫蒂(Rick and Morty)》和《權力的遊戲(Game of Thrones)》。

值得注意的是，這意味著將新成立的派拉蒙遊戲工作室與華納兄弟遊戲的內部開發團隊合併，包括Avalanche Software、NetherRealm Studios、Rocksteady Studios、TT Games以及位於蒙特利爾和波士頓的WB Games團隊。

在周二晚上發送給員工的電子郵件中，戈登宣布了以下內容，該郵件由《綜藝雜誌(Variety)》獲得：

“我們正在投資於未來的增長引擎，與我們在電視、電影和直銷消費者的核心目標並行：遊戲、體驗、消費產品和出版，”戈登寫道。“這些是我們策略的核心支柱，旨在在實體和數字世界中建立參與感和粉絲基礎。我們希望在消費者觀看、遊玩和互動的地方與他們會面。同時，我們看到機會可以基於DC漫畫的敘事來擴展我們的電子商務產品，將粉絲與他們喜愛的品牌聯繫起來。”

遊戲和體驗部門負責人德里斯科(Dan Driscoll)在自己的備忘錄中為他的團隊制定了計劃，他於六月被任命為派拉蒙新成立的視頻遊戲工作室的負責人，該工作室是派拉蒙和Skydance的遊戲資產的組合：

“我們讓客人在主題公園、度假村、餐廳、零售、工作室導覽等地沉浸其中。我們讓玩家沉浸在動作、冒險、戰鬥、競爭和創造力中，從《蝙蝠俠(Batman)》到《海綿寶寶(SpongeBob)》。無論你在這個團隊中的角色是什麼，你都是這些世界的創造者、建設者、運營者和守護者。我們有機會創造出令人驚嘆的空間，在這裡友誼得以建立，社區得以成長。這一切都只有因為你們的辛勤工作和才華才有可能。無論是在Zoom上還是面對面，在接下來的幾周裡，我的首要任務是盡可能多地與你們會面，從洛杉磯到倫敦，從蒙特利爾到東京，甚至更遠。”
